% LaTeX preamble for CERTA documents. Colours from docs/assets/visual-identity.png.
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{lastpage}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{fvextra}
\usepackage{booktabs}

\definecolor{certanavy}{HTML}{0B2D4A}
\definecolor{certateal}{HTML}{00BFA5}
\definecolor{certablue}{HTML}{0A6FB8}
\definecolor{certaice}{HTML}{E6EEF6}
\definecolor{certagrey}{HTML}{56687A}

% Headings
\titleformat{\section}{\color{certanavy}\Large\bfseries}{\thesection}{0.7em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\color{certanavy}\large\bfseries}{\thesubsection}{0.7em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}{\color{certanavy}\normalsize\bfseries}{\thesubsubsection}{0.7em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{1.6em}{0.6em}

% Header and footer
\setlength{\headheight}{24pt}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.6pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{\hbox to\headwidth{\color{certateal}\leaders\hrule height \headrulewidth\hfill}}
\newcommand{\certafooter}{%
  \fancyfoot[L]{\footnotesize\color{certagrey}CERTA · Certified, Embedded, Risk-aware Test design for Analog circuits}%
  \fancyfoot[R]{\footnotesize\color{certagrey}Page \thepage\ of \pageref*{LastPage}}}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\raisebox{-0.12cm}{\includegraphics[height=0.5cm]{\certaMarkPath}}\hspace{0.15cm}{\small\bfseries\color{certanavy}CERTA}}
\fancyhead[R]{\small\color{certagrey}\certaRunning}
\certafooter
\fancypagestyle{certafirst}{\fancyhf{}\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}\certafooter}

% Title block
\newcommand{\certamaketitle}{%
  \thispagestyle{certafirst}%
  \begingroup
  \noindent\includegraphics[height=1.4cm]{\certaLogoPath}\par
  \vspace{1.1cm}
  \ifdefempty{\certaDoctype}{}{\noindent{\small\bfseries\color{certateal}\MakeUppercase{\certaDoctype}}\par\vspace{0.25cm}}%
  {\noindent\raggedright\color{certanavy}\fontsize{24}{29}\selectfont\bfseries\certaTitle\par}
  \ifdefempty{\certaSubtitle}{}{\vspace{0.3cm}{\noindent\raggedright\large\color{certagrey}\certaSubtitle\par}}%
  \vspace{0.5cm}
  \noindent{\color{certateal}\rule{2.2cm}{2pt}}\par
  \vspace{0.35cm}
  \noindent{\small\color{certanavy}\certaAuthor\ifdefempty{\certaDate}{}{\quad·\quad\certaDate}\ifdefempty{\certaReference}{}{\quad·\quad\certaReference}}\par
  \vspace{0.9cm}
  \endgroup}

% Long lines in code blocks wrap instead of running past the margin
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{breaklines,commandchars=\\\{\}}
